feedback: [DATATYPE] MainShape > sh:or fallback > sh:sparql: The fallback branch checks only that constructionDate is bound and can therefore accept a non-xsd:date value for non-applicable Category C ships, and malformed values can bypass the applicability comparison. Required change: Enforce constructionDate as xsd:date outside the applicability sh:or, or add an equivalent datatype check to the fallback branch while preserving the 2017-01-01 comparison. | [UNIT_CONVERSION] MainShape > residualStabilityFactorSI > q:unit: The quantity constraint uses q:UNITLESS under the qudt schema namespace, but the supplied canonical recommended unit is http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS; the current hasValue therefore does not identify the canonical unit. Required change: Bind a unit prefix to http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/ and use that canonical UNITLESS IRI in sh:hasValue.

feedback: [LOGIC] MainShape/sh:or second branch/sh:sparql: The SPARQL branch is inverted for SHACL conformance: it selects non-applicable cases as violations, and also selects applicable category A/B ships constructed on or after 2017-01-01. Consequently, the outer sh:or rejects non-applicable cases with missing applicability data and rejects applicable cases even when the loading-condition requirements are satisfied. Required change: Make the SPARQL constraint select only cases that establish applicability, so the branch conforms when the category/date combination is outside category A or B on or after the threshold, while preserving xsd:date validation for every present constructionDate value. | [LOGIC] MainShape/sh:or first branch/loadingConditionCase/sh:node/sh:or: The residual-stability-factor alternative is allowed regardless of alternativeInstrumentApplicable. A loading condition with alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true and residualStabilityFactorSI=1 can therefore pass without alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true, although the declared formula requires the permitted alternative-instrument outcome when the alternative applies. Required change: Guard the residualStabilityFactorSI=1 branch with alternativeInstrumentApplicable=false, leaving the alternative branch as alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true together with alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true.

current_issues.regression_guard: Preserve conditional applicability: the per-loading-condition rule must apply only to category A or B ships constructed on or after 2017-01-01.
